title: AI Skill Toolkit SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Superset of the Anthropic Skills format. Only `name` and `description` are required by the official format and by this schema. The additional fields (`id`, `category`, `version`, `triggers`, `requires`) are toolkit-specific recommendations enforced by `scripts/validate-skills.ps1 -Strict`. Unknown top-level fields are allowed (e.g. legacy `origin`).

name.description: Human-readable skill name. Required by the Anthropic Skills format.

description.description: Activation summary used by skill dispatchers. ≤1024 characters. Required by the Anthropic Skills format. Should contain trigger phrases and (when relevant) skip conditions; offload long enumerations to `triggers.positive`.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must equal the parent folder name.

category.description: Top-level grouping used for routing and conflict resolution.

version.description: Semantic version of this skill definition (not the toolkit).

positive.description: Phrases or keywords that should activate this skill.

negative.description: Phrases or keywords that should suppress activation, even if positive triggers also match.

triggers.description: Bidirectional trigger model. Dispatchers should activate only when at least one positive trigger matches AND no negative trigger matches.

mcp.description: MCP servers the skill depends on (e.g. firecrawl, exa, context7). The skill should fail gracefully if any are missing.

os.description: Supported operating systems. Empty or unset = all.

bin.description: External executables required on PATH (e.g. python3, node, git).

requires.description: Hard dependencies. The validator does not check actual availability — it only checks the declaration shape.
